style: Palette of crimson tail-light red and warm sodium amber against dusky asphalt and dark sky, with pale chrome highlights. No text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere.

images.prompt: Low, wide chase-camera shot from just behind and beside a heavy armored futuristic motorcycle racing down an empty desert highway at dusk, its rider in a dark full-face helmet and a long armored riding coat leaning into the speed, crimson tail light streaking behind. Far ahead on the horizon, a convoy of armored getaway trucks kicks up a long plume of dust. Wide dusky sky with a pale moon. The lower left of the picture is open road.

Dynamic chase view on a coastal highway at sunset, seen from behind a heavy armored futuristic motorcycle racing between slow civilian cars. Beside it, a second armored motorbike with spiked plates and red lights drifts toward the guard rail, losing control. Ahead, a roadblock of stacked barrels and wooden crates bursts apart in sparks and splinters. Speed blur on the road, the sea glittering beside it.

Very high aerial view of one long winding highway crossing several landscapes in a single picture: red desert in the foreground, a snowy mountain pass in the middle, and a long bridge over a dark sea in the far distance. A tiny motorcycle with a crimson light trail rides in the foreground, and far, far ahead on the distant bridge a single armored getaway truck with amber lights. Late afternoon light, clear sky.

Tall vertical view down a long straight highway running toward a distant city skyline at night, a glowing ring of lights arcing across the sky. On the road in the middle distance, a heavy armored futuristic motorcycle seen from far behind, small in the frame, crimson tail light streaking. Far ahead, a big armored getaway truck with amber lights. Filling the sky above, a huge flying carrier ship with its hangar lights on.

Wide panoramic view of a frontier world at sunset: a colossal flying carrier ship with a hangar deck and amber running lights cruises low over a vast landscape of red desert, dark forests and a sea, a network of highways and long bridges below it running off to the horizon. High in the sky, a faint ring of orbital roads and lights circles the planet.
